'''Yeesre Mee''' was a [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] and the lead investigator of the events involved in the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Aks Moe/Legends|Aks Moe]] shortly before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
